requirements.title: Single-Cycle Signed INT8 MAC
requirements.text: The NPU shall compute signed 8-bit x 8-bit multiplication and accumulate into a 24-bit signed accumulator in a single clock cycle.

requirements.title: Systolic Array Scalability
requirements.text: The PE datapath shall provide systolic forward registers (data_a_out, data_b_out, cascade_acc_in) to enable parameterization across M x N grids.

requirements.title: Micro-Op Dynamic Configuration
requirements.text: The controller shall decode runtime opcodes (CMD_SET_LEN, CMD_SET_POST, CMD_ACC_OPS, CMD_LOAD_BIAS) when cmd_mode = 1.

requirements.title: Requantization, Rounding and Activation
requirements.text: The activation unit shall compute (Acc + 2^(S-1)) >> S with half-integer rounding and saturation to [-128, 127] or [0, 255] and ReLU.

requirements.title: Winner-Take-All ArgMax Unit
requirements.text: The ArgMax unit shall record the maximum signed class score and report the winning 4-bit class index upon comparison strobe.

requirements.title: Tiny Tapeout 1x1 Standard Pinout
requirements.text: The top module shall map to Tiny Tapeout standard pins (ui_in[7:0], uo_out[7:0], uio[7:0]) and operate at 50 MHz.
